tools.name: find_pickup_points

findings.detail: Description of "create_checkout" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "confirm_reservation_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_reservation_status · Private data: request_confirmation_code, cancel_reservation, request_extension · Public sink: create_reservation, get_reservation_status, start_reservation_management · Destructive: search_offers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_reservation_status · Private data: request_confirmation_code, cancel_reservation, request_extension · Public sink: create_reservation, get_reservation_status, start_reservation_management · Destructive: search_offers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
